translation_notes: NOT-EXPRESSIBLE: the query is `_CQ_SPARQL_PREFIXES + cq.get("sparql_equiv", "").strip()` -- an entire query received as DATA (a competency question's SPARQL stored in a record), prefixed by a constant PREFIX block. s{ } needs its query written literally (parsed at transpile time); there is no island for 'run this query text I was handed'. Minimal excerpt: `graph.query(_CQ_SPARQL_PREFIXES + query)`. The constant prologue is the one part that has an equivalent (@prefix), but it only exists to be prepended to the received text, so it has nothing to attach to.
The error path (`except Exception: return (0, "ERROR")`) depends on the text being validated at RUN time, which s{ } moves to transpile time: another reason it cannot apply.
translated.ldpy is identical to original.py (exact transparency); constructions is empty on purpose.

Driver: fixture.ttl is a small ontology in the prologue's `:` namespace; 18 calls cover N/A (graph None, no sparql_equiv, blank), PASS/FAIL for queries with rows (through each of the five prologue prefixes) and without, an ASK, a malformed query and an undeclared prefix (ERROR), the prologue's `:` redeclared (to another IRI: FAIL; to the same: PASS), and a cq without expected_non_empty (KeyError compared as a raise). Mutant: changing the skos PREFIX IRI in the prologue makes the check FAIL (call[7]).
